entities.name: Luis Guillermo de Moncada, 7th Duke of Montalto
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Guillermo de Moncada Aragon Luna y Cardona was a Spanish nobleman and Roman Catholic cardinal. He was a Knight of the Military Order of Alcantara in 1630, Viceroy of Sicily 1635 -1639, Captain General and Viceroy of Sardinia (1644), Viceroy of Valencia in 1652 and a Knight of the Order of the Golden Fleece in 1651.
